item.description:
## 🛒 `GET /cart/items` – Get All Cart Items

**Description**: Returns a list of all items in the authenticated user's cart, including product details and status.

### 🔒 Authentication

- Required: Yes (Customer only)
    

### 📥 Request

- No body required
    

### ✅ Success Response `200 OK`

``` json
[
  {
    "cart_item_id": 3,
    "product": {
      "id": 12,
      "title": "Wireless Headphones",
      "slug": "wireless-headphones",
      "description": "High-quality wireless headphones with noise cancellation.",
      "image": "http://localhost:8000/media/product_images/headphones.jpg",
      "price": "149.99",
      "stock_quantity": 20,
      "is_active": true,
      "category": {
        "id": 4,
        "name": "Electronics",
        "slug": "electronics",
        "parent_category": null
      },
      "seller": {
        "id": 7,
        "company_name": "TechZone"
      },
      "created_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z"
    },
    "quantity": 2,
    "item_subtotal": "299.98",
    "status": "available",
    "message": "Product is available and in stock"
  }
]

 ```

### ❌ Error Response

``` json
{
  "detail": "Authentication credentials were not provided."
}

 ```

---

## ➕ `POST /cart/additem` – Add Product to Cart

**Description**: Adds a product to the authenticated user’s cart or increases quantity if the product already exists in the cart.

### 🔒 Authentication

- Required: Yes
    

### 📥 Request Body

``` json
{
  "product_id": 12,
  "quantity": 2
}

 ```

### ✅ Success Response `201 CREATED` (New item)

``` json
{
  "detail": "Item added to cart successfully.",
  "product_id": 12,
  "quantity": 2
}

 ```

### ✅ Success Response `200 OK` (Quantity updated)

``` json
{
  "detail": "Quantity updated successfully.",
  "product_id": 12,
  "new_quantity": 4
}

 ```

### ❌ Error Responses

#### Quantity exceeds stock

``` json
{
  "detail": "Sorry this quantity (6) exceeds stock (5)"
}

 ```

#### Invalid product or quantity

``` json
{
  "non_field_errors": ["Product does not exist."]
}

 ```

#### Inactive product

``` json
{
  "non_field_errors": ["This product is not available anymore."]
}

 ```

---

## 🧺 `GET /cart/items/` – Get Single Cart Item

**Description**: Returns details of a specific cart item by ID.

### ✅ Response `200 OK`

``` json
{
  "cart_item_id": 3,
  "product": {
    "id": 12,
    "title": "Wireless Headphones",
    "slug": "wireless-headphones",
    "description": "High-quality wireless headphones with noise cancellation.",
    "image": "http://localhost:8000/media/product_images/headphones.jpg",
    "price": "149.99",
    "stock_quantity": 20,
    "is_active": true,
    "category": {
      "id": 4,
      "name": "Electronics",
      "slug": "electronics",
      "parent_category": null
    },
    "seller": {
      "id": 7,
      "company_name": "TechZone"
    },
    "created_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z"
  },
  "quantity": 2,
  "item_subtotal": "299.98",
  "status": "available",
  "message": "Product is available and in stock"
}

 ```

### ❌ Response `404 NOT FOUND`

``` json
{
  "detail": "Not found."
}

 ```

---

## 🔼 `POST /cart/increase/` – Increase Quantity by 1

### ✅ Response

``` json
{
  "detail": "Quantity increased.",
  "product_id": 12,
  "quantity": 3
}

 ```

### ❌ Not enough stock

``` json
{
  "detail": "Not enough stock"
}

 ```

---

## 🔽 `POST /cart/decrease/` – Decrease Quantity by 1

### ✅ Response

``` json
{
  "detail": "Quantity decreased.",
  "product_id": 12,
  "quantity": 1
}

 ```

### ❌ Cannot go below 1

``` json
{
  "detail": "Quantity cannot be less than 1."
}

 ```

---

## 🛠️ `PATCH /cart/update/` – Set Quantity

**Description**: Updates the quantity of a cart item to a specific value.

### 📥 Request Body

``` json
{
  "quantity": 4
}

 ```

### ✅ Response

``` json
{
  "cart_item_id": 3,
  "product": {
    "id": 12,
    "title": "Wireless Headphones",
    "slug": "wireless-headphones",
    "description": "High-quality wireless headphones with noise cancellation.",
    "image": "http://localhost:8000/media/product_images/headphones.jpg",
    "price": "149.99",
    "stock_quantity": 20,
    "is_active": true,
    "category": {
      "id": 4,
      "name": "Electronics",
      "slug": "electronics",
      "parent_category": null
    },
    "seller": {
      "id": 7,
      "company_name": "TechZone"
    },
    "created_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2025-08-15T09:31:00Z"
  },
  "quantity": 4,
  "item_subtotal": "599.96",
  "status": "available",
  "message": "Product is available and in stock"
}

 ```

### ❌ Error Response

``` json
{
  "quantity": ["Not enough stock available."]
}

 ```
